summary: Campus waste system shows 62% diversion with 18% contamination in target bins. 1,247 items tracked, 773 recovered. Canteen organic waste and Hostel A recyclables are top contamination sources.
issues: Recyclable bin contamination at 18% cuts recycling yield from 85% to 55%
Canteen generates 60% biodegradable waste but 40% goes to residual
Hazardous items (batteries) found in general waste pose fire risk

actions.title: Launch targeted bin signage campaign
actions.why: Contamination rate of 18% suggests confusion about what goes where

actions.title: Add organic bins at Canteen with clear labeling
actions.why: Canteen generates 60% biodegradable waste but contamination is high

actions.title: Hazardous waste awareness drive for batteries
actions.why: Batteries found in general waste pose fire risk in compactors

reuse_ideas: Glass jars → storage containers, planters, candle holders
Cardboard boxes → drawer organizers, compost brown material, kids' crafts
Old textiles → cleaning rags, pet bedding, tote bags
Plastic containers → seed starters, hardware organizers, paint trays
Aluminum cans → candle molds, herb planters, wind chimes
disclaimer: Guidance is informational. Local disposal rules may vary. Consult facility staff for hazardous items.
